/*selectSggInqList YOO.CHI.HOON*/ WITH /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.SggInqMapper.selectSggInqList(시군구목록조회) */ SGG_LIST AS ( SELECT T1.CTPV_SE_CD AS CTPV_SE_CD /* 시도구분코드*/ , T1.CTPV_NM AS CTPV_NM /* 시도명*/ , T1.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD /* 시군구코드*/ , T1.SGG_NM AS SGG_NM /* 시군구명*/ , T1.CTPV_NM || ' ' || T1.SGG_NM AS RGN_NM /* 시도명||시군구명*/ , T1.ENG_CTPV_NM AS ENG_CTPV_NM /* 영문시도명*/ , T1.ENG_SGG_NM AS ENG_SGG_NM /* 영문시군구명*/ , T1.ENG_CTPV_NM || ' ' || T1.ENG_SGG_NM AS ENG_RGN_NM /* 영문시도||영문시군구명*/ , NVL(T1.DEL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부*/ , CASE WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '11' THEN 1 /* 서울*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '26' THEN 2 /* 부산*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '27' THEN 3 /* 대구*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '28' THEN 4 /* 인천*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '29' THEN 5 /* 광주*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '30' THEN 6 /* 대전*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '31' THEN 7 /* 울산*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '36' THEN 8 /* 세종*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '41' THEN 9 /* 경기*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '42' THEN 10 /* 강원*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '43' THEN 11 /* 충청북도*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '44' THEN 12 /* 충청남도*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '45' THEN 13 /* 전라북도*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '46' THEN 14 /* 전라남도*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '47' THEN 15 /* 경상북도*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '48' THEN 16 /* 경상남도*/ WHEN T1.CTPV_SE_CD = '50' THEN 17 /* 제주*/ ELSE 99 END AS SRTNG_SQNCE /* 정렬순서*/ , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록일자*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최초수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ FROM SAA020 T1 /* 시군구코드*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부*/ ORDER BY T1.CTPV_SE_CD /* 시도구분코드*/ ) SELECT T.CTPV_SE_CD AS CTPV_SE_CD /* 시도구분코드*/ , T.CTPV_NM AS CTPV_NM /* 시도명*/ , T.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD /* 시군구코드*/ , T.SGG_NM AS SGG_NM /* 시군구명*/ , T.RGN_NM AS RGN_NM /* 시도명||시군구명*/ , T.ENG_CTPV_NM AS ENG_CTPV_NM /* 영문시도명*/ , T.ENG_SGG_NM AS ENG_SGG_NM /* 영문시군구명*/ , T.ENG_RGN_NM AS ENG_RGN_NM /* 영문시도||영문시군구명*/ , T.SRTNG_SQNCE AS SRTNG_SQNCE /* 정렬순서*/ FROM SGG_LIST T WHERE 1 = 1
AND T.CTPV_SE_CD = #{CTPV_SE_CD} /* 시도구분코드*/
AND T.SGG_CD = #{SGG_CD} /* 시군구코드*/
AND T.CTPV_NM LIKE '%'||#{CTPV_NM}||'%' /* 시도명*/
AND T.SGG_NM LIKE '%'||#{SGG_NM}||'%' /* 시군구명*/
ORDER BY T.CTPV_SE_CD, T.SRTNG_SQNCE

SAA020 T1 /* 시군구코드*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부*/ ORDER BY T1.SGG_CD, T1.SRTNG_SQNCE ), V_CTPV_SGG_LIST AS ( SELECT T3.* FROM V_CTPV_LIST T3 WHERE T3.CMMNS_CD_ID = #{CMMNS_CD_ID} UNION ALL SELECT T4.* FROM V_SGG_LIST T4 WHERE T4.CMMNS_CD_ID = #{CMMNS_CD_ID} ) SELECT T.SGG_CD /*시군구코드*/ , T.CTPV_SE_CD /*시도명*/ , T.CTPV_NM /*시도명*/ , T.SGG_NM /*시군구명*/ , T.SRTNG_SQNCE /*정렬순서*/ FROM
